answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 3330 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: A flat in Makkah is occupied for some 6 months during the year commencing Rajab until the Dhul Hajj.During this time the rent is multiplied many times than the routine rent. Is the rental income halal? Question: A flat in Makkah is occupied for some 6 months during the year commencing Rajab until the Dhul Hajj.During this time the rent is multiplied many times than the routine rent. Is the rental income halal? Answer ID: 3330 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 357/317=B) If you own nisab you have to pay zakah of the capital and profit both. (2) As it is unlawful for a bank employee to write interest accounts likewise it is unlawful to give interest loans, and the charge of unlawful work is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
